purpose: Determine whether the persistent B05 groundwater event defect is caused by insufficient state count or by lower-focused placement, using equal-dimension G8 and U8 with same-partition Richards controls.

prospective_interpretation.LOWER_FOCUSED_STATE_COUNT_VALUE: G8 is componentwise no worse than prior G6 on event vector with strict improvement, and G8 is componentwise no worse than U8.
prospective_interpretation.PLACEMENT_MISMATCH_SUPPORTED: U8 is componentwise no worse than G8 on event vector with strict improvement.
prospective_interpretation.EIGHT_STATE_REPRESENTATION_INSUFFICIENT: Neither G8 nor U8 improves the persistent G6 event failure materially.
prospective_interpretation.CLOSURE_EFFECT_EMERGES_AT_EIGHT_STATES: Same-partition Richards is strictly componentwise better than Layer-ROM for the same G8 or U8 event vector.
prospective_interpretation.MIXED: relations do not fit one of the above clean cases.

stop_rules: No empirical correction or B05-specific tuning.
No application acceptance or production admission.
